name: pending-signal-inspect-fix
description: Fix 2 issues in the pending-signal inspect popup of the live GUI: (1) the popup chart in the inspect window does not show the entry point, and SL/TP lines are hidden — likely because price has moved far from the entry level and the chart viewport/scale no longer fits the entry zone; (2) the timestamp displayed as "time entry point was found" is the scan time (M15 scan moment) instead of the signal's actual entry time. Independent investigation first, then implementation of both fixes, then QA review — the same pattern as the previous gui_display_fix_team.

tasks.subject: Investigate inspect-popup defects (entry/SL/TP visibility + entry-time vs scan-time) and write fix requirements
tasks.description:
Two user-reported defects in the pending-signal inspect popup (workspace: /Users/a/Documents/deepseek harness/kien-workspace, GUI under trading_live/live/):

Defect 1 — chart fit: In the inspect popup (SignalInspectDialog in trading_live/live/gui/gui_tab_live.py + CandlestickChart in trading_live/live/gui/chart_widget.py) the entry point is not visible and the SL/TP dashed lines are covered/hidden, likely because price has run far from the entry level. Note: paintEvent DOES include marker levels in lo/hi, so verify whether the actual failure is the level band being crushed to an edge sliver (lines/labels overlapping or clipped), zero/None levels degenerating the range (e.g. level 0.0 pulling the scale), lines rendering off-plot, or a combination. Reproduce with a synthetic offscreen render (QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen) where candles are N dollars from entry/SL/TP.

Defect 2 — entry time: The pending-signals window (gui_tab_live.py table, ~line 383-396) and the inspect dialog show the moment the signal was FOUND by the M15 scan, not the signal's actual entry time. Likely chain: signal_engine_v2.py SignalCandidate carries entry_time (candle/datetime of the entry bar, line ~80-87, ~451) → signal_polling_engine_v2.py _process_candidate (line ~518-528) creates PendingSignal with timestamp=time.time() and drops entry_time → shared_app_state_v2.py PendingSignal dataclass (line ~97-106) has only timestamp → snapshot serialization (line ~768-781) exposes only timestamp → GUI renders sig['timestamp'] everywhere. Verify each hop and check whether cand.entry_time survives anywhere in the pending signal payload.

Deliverable: a markdown fix-spec report (suggested path trading_live/research/inspect_popup_fix_requirements.md) covering: root causes with file:line evidence for both defects; the complete data-flow change needed to carry entry_time end-to-end (dataclass field, polling-engine construction, snapshot serialization, GUI table + dialog display, plus a clear labeled fallback when entry_time is missing, e.g. older signals); the chosen chart fit strategy for defect 1 (e.g. fit/zoom so the entry band always gets a guaranteed visible fraction of plot height, padding, label-visible handling, guarding zero/None levels, marker emphasis) with the tradeoffs; and constraints (no GUI-thread MCP/network calls, RLock respected, PySide6-only, existing _InspectLoadWorker async pattern preserved).
